_note: A sum qualifying under Income-tax Act, 2025 s.126(2)(b): "to effect or to keep in force the health insurance, or any payment made for preventive health check-up, for the parent or parents of the assessee, up to ₹25000 in aggregate" (Gazette 265620, p.161). Entered only as a HealthPayment, never a plain qualifying payment: the limits turn on whom it covers — family ("the spouse and dependant children", s.126(10)(b)) or parents, senior citizen or not (s.126(7), (8)(a)). The insurer's scheme must be approved (s.126(11)) — an entry condition. D-136. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.80D(2)(b): insurance on the health of the parent or parents, or their preventive check-up — no scheme (thc p.341). sources/2026-10-07-chapter-via.md B11; D-145.
displayName: Health insurance and check-ups for your parents
